content: Tlaihnawh a hmangpaw mehrung sahlo raering pehnah
Naaning mehrung a cangpaw sahlo, nge tua o, naa cung letei a tlungpaw vaichianah rawng tah caw le sang tah ung tua o.
Naa cho cawh hmai thlu myca ka, naa chaichi sahlo cawh luichaw tah a e thlu myca he.
Naa sui le naa ngung cawh asai tah a e thlu thah he. Ma asai enah tahei naaning khah sua ca phosá he ka, me hratah naa saw a ca e he a. Ma caichangnah a cangpaw lehei cho khah naa pakhong he ceh!
Ngetua hmai o! Naa ly letei saang a hrepaw, aa nihlo naa peh lypaw he raihrepaw sahlo tah aa ca yso leimei he. Saang a hrepaw sahlo aa y sangnah cawh Cungnungcai Abuipaw tah a thui myca.
Naaning cawh aluicung lehei du tling teitah le naa dunah pawtah naa ung. Thaw lepaw saw hratah pialinglang tah naa tung he ceh.
Naaning a ca dy lypaw he, suanah a hnui lypaw cawngsaw sahlo khah sua phosah he ceh ka, naa thaw he.
Lungsy tah ingnah

Uny sahlo, mataico Abuipaw a vongkawnah tai lungsy tah ung thlang my lo. Lythlopaw tah a ly taitei a chuapaw saze a sungnawpaw a hawpaw khah le khuatui hmasawpaw le khuatui hningcaipaw a va chuapaw a hawnah letei a lung a sypaw khah pacang tua my lo.
Naaning zong lungsy tah ung la, cyky tah a daw thlang my lo, zecawtamaw tatah Abuipaw a vong kaw nápaw cawh a ne myca hi.
Uny sahlo, pakheh le pakheh a mochia khe lo, biacepah cang sua lehe ceh ka. Biacetu cawh ingkaw letah a daw thlang hi!
Uny sahlo, Abuipaw ming tei bia a reilaipaw he Khazing khuavang sahlo khah taithuinah le lungsynah kong letah a mingpai my lo.

Naa hni thlangpaw hratah te a riapaw cawngsaw sahlo cawh bonghnang song a cang he kaa tah tei kho. Job a terianah khah hni he ceh ka, Abuipaw tah a hning tah a peh kawnah kong zong naa hni thlang kho. Abuipaw cawh zawngrawhnah le zaangsawnah khatah a chihpaw a cang hi.

Ka uny sahlo, ma vytei hlui taihei chiasahnah khah vaicung tamaw, alui tamaw, ze hringpaw hming tamaw tua khe lo. A cang caco, “A cang,” tah la, a cang ly caco, “Cang be,” tah thlang my lo. Sua phosah cang sua le he ceh ka.
Zingnah thlawchang
Naa hrong letah hanah a tongpaw na ung he ceh maw? Thlawchang seh. A lung a lawngpaw na ung he ceh maw? Reithainah hlaw khah sah seh.
A sahpaw na ung he ceh maw? Thlaw a changpah rua pawtah le Abuipaw ming tah sathy a thupah rua pawtah khrisaw macang sahlo khah y he seh.
Taico, zing hmotah thlawchangnah taco a sahpaw cawh a dang sá a. Abuipaw tah ama cawh a patho a. Suanah a tuapaw a cang caco, ngethai a cang a.
Macawtaco pakheh le pakheh sua biachaw a cui la, thlawchang a baw my lo, ma pawsui co naa dang khy hi. Mehdingpaw a thlawchangnah cawh hming a tua khypaw le mua a hnuipaw a cang.
Elija cawh kaaning hapaw cawngsaw a cang thlang. Khua a so ly nápawtah chahnainge teitah thlawchang ka, aa raang chung letah kung thung le a chy khua so lytah a ung.
Thlawchang kaw ka, avai taco khua cawh sosah ka, alui taco sazeno cawh a chuasah kaw.
Ka uny sahlo, pakhehpaw cawh biahmuisui taitah langtlui sua katei, pakheh kheh tah a va kawkhui kaw caco,
“Mehsuapaw khah a pánah langpui taitei a va paleh khuipaw cawngsaw taco ama cawh thihnah taitah pachah ka, suanah a hlupui khah ngethai tah a cangsah,” tahpaw bia heh a thui thlang my lo.
